update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.23 - Assistant tooling: auto-tuner, skill planner, live rank projection
Added ----- - Post-career auto-tuner. After a run, tap the wand on Training Settings to get suggested preset edits (stat targets, failure cap, priorities) derived from the run's archive, and apply them with one tap. - SP-aware skill purchase suggestions. The skill plan editor has a "Suggest plan" button: enter your SP budget and it fills a plan that maximizes relevant skills within budget, respecting gold-skill prerequisites. - Live final-rank projection. The remote log viewer shows a projected-grade chip next to Estimated Rank, extrapolated from your score trajectory to the finale and floored at your current score. The same projection appears as a "Projected rank" field in the Discord live-status embed. - Support Card Scan debug test and a per-device rainbow calibration fitter: groundwork for screenshot-based deck import and tuned rainbow detection. These are calibration tools -- run the debug tests to gather device data.
Notes ----- - Champions Meeting targeting for CM16 (Leo Cup) is delivered via an importable preset, not a code change.
